President Biden’s Plan
- Lower health insurance premiums permanently
- Keep kids covered under Medicaid
- Let Medicare negotiate drug prices for at least 50 drugs every year
- Cap out-of-pocket prescription drug costs for everyone
- Cap Medicare cost-sharing at $2 for common generic drugs
- Protect and strengthen Medicare for generations
- Cap insulin at $35 a month for everyone

House GOP’s Plan
- Raise health insurance premiums
- Take guaranteed health benefits away from 30 million kids enrolled in Medicaid
- Get rid of Medicare’s ability to negotiate lower prescription drug costs
- Eliminate the $2,000 out-of-pocket prescription drug cap for seniors
- Give massive handouts to Big Pharma
- Slash Medicare
- Repeal the $35 a month insulin cap for seniors
